purpose: Operationalize the already-frozen 22 semantic obligation classes without architecture names. This file freezes workload scaling, positive/twin pairing, admissibility and search attribution before gmi_k4_search.py produces any protected result.
name_barrier: The generator and search engine may read family id, obligation_class, phase_prediction, negative_twin and kill_condition. They MUST NOT read name_key during generation, ranking, search, measurement or scoring. property_vector is withheld from ranking and used only after the winner is frozen for verdict comparison.
protected_pairing: Every cell is evaluated on a positive world and its frozen negative twin. The same family/cell seed deterministically generates both. A K4 recovery requires the positive winner to match the frozen property vector and the negative twin to change the winning measured vector or make the positive mechanism inadmissible. No-twin-flip is a theory/phase-law RED, not a search success.

ranking.secondary: minimum scalarized lifecycle burden over the nine charged channels
ranking.tertiary: smaller neutral program description, then canonical candidate serialization

candidate_scope.rule: finite exhaustive neutral mechanism palette; no historical architecture macro is a candidate primitive
candidate_scope.coverage: If the full declared palette is scored, the cell is exhaustive regardless of the numeric --budget. If a future palette exceeds budget, the task must report non-exhaustive coverage and cannot use THEORY_RED unless the frozen predicted witness was independently constructed inside the searched cap.
candidate_scope.same_author_limitation: The palette is same-authored and therefore does NOT close IG-5 primitive-selection independence. K4 receipts from this engine must carry PENDING_INDEPENDENT_PRIMITIVES even when recovery is green.

control_rule: All four controls must be recovered by the same grammar implementation before INCONCLUSIVE_SEARCH is an allowed diagnosis. A control failure is INCONCLUSIVE_GRAMMAR_OR_HARNESS.
generator_rule: Each obligation generator is a deterministic semantic world family keyed only by obligation_class, cell scale and seed. Random coefficients/labels/topologies use the task seed; no draw is rejected because of search outcome.
prohibited: changing a generator after seeing its protected result without retiring the split
dropping failed tasks from aggregate receipts
claim_ceiling: This freeze makes K4 executable and auditable but does not close IG-4 meter bucketing, IG-5 primitive authorship, learning-scale realism or K5 held-family prediction by itself.
